product.summary: Wearable NFC hardware wallet that shares the current Tangem hardware-wallet architecture in a ring form factor.
product.notes: Tangem's current material describes Ring as functionally equivalent to current wallet cards except for form factor. Year-level launch anchor is used rather than an unsupported exact release day.

events.title: Tangem Ring opened for public preorders
events.description: Tangem opened public preorders for the Tangem Ring on July 17, 2024 after unveiling the wearable hardware wallet at the 2023 Cardano Summit.
events.notes: This is a preorder milestone, not an asserted general-availability or shipping date. Tangem stated deliveries would begin later in 2024.

evidence.title: Wallet Types: Mobile vs Hardware
evidence.notes: Primary source separating Mobile Wallet from hardware card/ring wallet and describing their different key-storage boundaries.

evidence.title: Tangem Ring
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page confirming the ring-shaped hardware wallet, current sale, and functional relationship to current Tangem cards.

evidence.title: What is the Tangem Ring?
evidence.notes: Primary Tangem source stating the Ring was unveiled at the 2023 Cardano Summit and became available for preorders on July 17, 2024.
